title: Logical Vs Physical Backups
summary: pg_dump produces logical SQL or archive content for selected databases and portable restores. pg_basebackup plus WAL archive captures a physical cluster timeline for point-in-time recovery. The right answer depends on object scope, RPO, RTO, version movement, and corruption posture.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of Logical Vs Physical Backups.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
